children: Azizi Hospitality, a key unit of UAE-based Azizi Developments, has announced that work is moving at a steady pace on its five-star hotel in Azizi Riviera, Meydan, with the property on track for opening in mid-2028.

The hotel is part of Azizi Hospitality’s planned expansion across the UAE. The company has previously announced plans to invest AED75 billion ($20.4 billion) in 151 hotels, mainly in Dubai, with the portfolio expected to comprise about 60,000 rooms and create more than 75,000 jobs.
Work at the Azizi Riviera site has begun with excavation and foundation works, with the main structural construction, facade installation and interior fit-out to follow, the company said.
Located within the vibrant, amenity-rich community of Azizi Riviera, the hotel is planned to include accommodation, restaurants, wellness and leisure facilities, as well as a children's club and gym.

Azizi Hospitality is also developing a full-scale mock-up of a guest room, corridor and lift lobby to test layouts, materials and design elements before they are incorporated across the hotel, the company said.

The vision sets the direction for both the architecture and the guest experience, from the guest rooms to the Italian and Asian restaurants, wellness facilities, kids’ club, gym and landscaped surroundings, it added.

On the Meydan project, Group CEO Farhad Azizi, said: "Great hospitality isn't measured in room counts. It's measured in whether people leave wanting to return. Everything we build is designed around that test, down to the details most guests feel but never notice, how a space flows, how light falls, how it makes you feel the moment you walk in."
"It's the same standard we intend to bring to every property we build, each with a character of its own, each adding to Dubai's standing as one of the world's leading destinations," he added.

To get every detail right, the team is building a full-scale mock-up, a real guest room, corridor and lift lobby, allowing the space to be experienced exactly as a future guest would and giving the team the chance to refine layout, materials, flow and overall feel before those choices are carried through the hotel.

Behind the construction program, Azizi Hospitality is also shaping the elements that will ultimately bring the hotel to life, from the guest journey and operating model to the food and beverage concepts, wellness offering, technology, service standards, procurement and pre-opening preparations.

Azizi Hospitality CEO Saurabh Bakshi said: "A hotel is made long before the first guest arrives, in the decisions most people never see. That is why we are shaping the experience, the operations and the finest details in step with the build itself. The mock-up room captures that discipline: it lets us step into the guest experience early, test what works and refine it well before we reach the final stages."

The coming phases will focus on the main structural build and the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, followed by the interior fit-out, the furniture and fittings that bring each space to life, and the equipment that keeps the hotel running day to day. The final stages will move into readying the property for operation, he added.

title: ZAWYA: Azizi's new Meydan 5-star property set for mid-2028 opening
